nodes.description: Severe primary TMAU results from homozygous or compound-heterozygous inactivating FMO3 variants. Recurrent severe alleles include the catalytically inactivating p.Pro153Leu missense variant and the p.Glu305* nonsense variant; milder/intermittent disease is associated with common hypomorphic haplotypes (e.g., p.Glu158Lys;p.Glu308Gly).

This is the rate-limiting detoxication step for gut-derived TMA in the liver.

nodes.description: Trimethylamine is generated by the gut microbiota from reduction of dietary precursors including trimethylamine-N-oxide (abundant in marine fish), choline, and carnitine. With hepatic N-oxidation impaired, the free amine accumulates and is excreted unchanged in urine, sweat, saliva, and expired air.
